office_does: The auditor runs the county's elections and records deeds and other documents; in Douglas County the office also handles licensing, payroll, accounts payable and budgeting.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Thad Duvall (Prefers Nonpartisan Party), auditor since his 1997 appointment and elected eight times, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Douglas County Auditor since 1997 and a past president of the state county auditors' association; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Appointed auditor in 1997 and elected eight times since, by his statement [S1]
Past president of the Washington State Association of County Auditors [S1]
